title: 12-name watchlist · 4 November 2026, 08:00 SGT
summary: Ten watchlist names rose and two fell at the completed 3 November US regular-session close. AMD led at +3.65%; Apple fell 1.90%. New in this review window: AMD reported Q3 results and Q4 guidance, while Meta filed final pricing for a $15 billion senior-note offering. Amazon filed a backward-looking 13F. Apple’s developer-preview item is explicitly earlier catch-up, not overnight breaking news.
coverage_note: Review window: 4 November 2026, 04:00–08:00 SGT (3 November 20:00–4 November 00:00 UTC), with a 15-minute overlap. The previous 04:00 SGT edition and all older artifacts remain available unchanged. This edition replaces the prior in-progress session snapshots with the verified completed 3 November close and recomputed six-horizon returns. New research is separated from earlier catch-up; quiet names do not receive filler. News coverage is partial, not a complete newswire census.
price_basis: All main prices are USD completed regular-session observations for 3 November 2026, at 16:00 EST (4 November 05:00 SGT), with individually recorded vendor quote timestamps. Daily change compares the 2 November ordinary close. Yahoo supplies seconds for some observations; Stock Analysis supplies minute precision, preserved without invented seconds. These are saved closes, not live or exact 08:00 SGT prices. No after-hours price has been substituted for a regular close; premarket fields are null. TSM is the US-listed USD ADR.
return_basis: Cumulative return = 100 × (3 November 2026 adjusted close ÷ baseline adjusted close − 1). The 1–6 calendar-month baselines are 2 October, 3 September, 3 August, 2 July, 3 June and 1 May 2026. October 3 and May 3 fall on weekends; July 3 is the observed US Independence Day market holiday, so preceding sessions are used. All 72 dated inputs were independently checked. Adjusted closes incorporate split and dividend/distribution adjustments; ordinary previous closes remain separate. These are cumulative returns before fees and taxes, not six individual monthly returns.
caveats: We could not independently verify a reliably timestamped after-hours price for this edition. Quotes and financial events use separate timestamps. AMD results and Meta pricing occurred after the regular close; the close prices do not include their subsequent after-hours reaction.

All prices and 72 adjusted-close baseline inputs were independently rechecked. Vendor values may later be revised. Current endpoints were crosschecked against completed history rows; intraday or unfinalized observations were rejected.

Direct Yahoo pages were rate-limited. Current search-indexed Yahoo historical rows, including regional pages, supplied some older adjusted baselines; direct Stock Analysis and current Quiver history supplied others. Sources are linked beside every calculation.

TSM uses Yahoo-adjusted historical baselines consistently, including 3 September at 415.89 rather than the 416.13 in Stock Analysis. Its finalized 404.80 close is not the earlier 15:59:59 observation of 404.66.

Existing dated editions, calls, reports and their qualifications are retained unchanged. Old active-session and premarket snapshots remain in their original archives rather than being represented as current observations.
Watch only: no current holding, executed trade, user buy call or recommendation is implied. No private diary, brokerage record, personal account information or restricted screenshot is included.
Apple’s Siri developer-preview post is timestamped 18:00:20 UTC before this window and explicitly labelled earlier catch-up. Meta priced terms do not establish completed settlement.

Reuters coverage used targeted searches and accessible indexed syndication. Direct Reuters AMD article could not be opened, and direct access to the two syndicated articles returned 403; indexed versions were readable. Coverage is partial.
Alphabet, Meta and Micron news-release lists were incomplete or did not render. Broadcom’s current list was successfully accessed at its new financial-news URL.
No unverified after-hours percentage from Reuters is included: syndicated copies carry differing market reactions and do not expose a reliable final update timestamp.
AMD official release and SEC earnings filing were read; a complete earnings-call transcript was not independently reviewed.
All 12 SEC recent-submission feeds were checked through the cutoff. This does not constitute a complete census of third-party ownership filings or every company announcement.
No newly verified item for a ticker is not a blanket no-news finding.

rows.name: Apple

research.headline: Earlier update newly checked: Siri AI developer preview expands
facts: Apple’s official Developer RSS dates this post to 18:00:20 UTC (4 November 02:00:20 SGT), before this review window. It was absent from the preceding edition.

The preview lets developers integrate app content and actions with Siri AI through App Intents in the 27.3 betas. Apple describes customer availability in a few months and App Store submissions opening in spring.
research.analysis: Broader third-party integration could increase useful Siri experiences, but the announcement supplies no revenue estimate.
research.risks: This remains a preview with device, language and regional limits. Apple says Siri AI is unavailable in the EU on iOS, iPadOS and watchOS; terms and usage policies are still to follow.
research.next_watch: Developer uptake, final policies and customer-release timing.

rows.name: Meta Platforms

research.headline: New priced terms: $15 billion senior-note offering
facts: Meta filed final pricing terms at 22:25:13 UTC (4 November 06:25:13 SGT), replacing the earlier preliminary filing’s blank amounts and coupons.

The five tranches are $3.25 billion at 5.850% due 2031, $3.25 billion at 6.250% due 2033, $4 billion at 6.550% due 2036, $1.75 billion at 7.350% due 2046 and $2.75 billion at 7.500% due 2056. Settlement is expected on 5 November.
research.analysis: The filing establishes the dollar offering’s size and borrowing cost, a concrete financing update beyond the earlier launch.
research.risks: Pricing is not completed settlement. This term sheet does not establish final terms or completion of any separate euro offering.
research.next_watch: Expected 5 November settlement and subsequent completion disclosures.

rows.name: Advanced Micro Devices

research.headline: New results: Data Center drives record Q3; Q4 revenue guide rises
facts: AMD released Q3 results at 21:15 UTC (4 November 05:15 SGT): revenue $13.377 billion, up 45% year-on-year; diluted EPS $1.46 GAAP and $2.09 non-GAAP.

Data Center revenue was $8.546 billion, up 97%; Client and Gaming revenue fell 8% to $3.722 billion. Q4 guidance is $17 billion revenue, plus or minus 3%, and approximately 55% non-GAAP gross margin versus 56% in Q3.
research.analysis: The revenue midpoint implies approximately 27% sequential growth, but a lower adjusted gross margin. Strong Data Center growth and weaker Client and Gaming demand need separate evaluation.
research.risks: Guidance depends on execution of the Helios and Venice ramp and component supply. Non-GAAP EPS is not GAAP earnings.
research.next_watch: Q4 shipment execution, margin delivery and additional official call materials. The scheduled 22:00 UTC call is no longer an upcoming event at this cutoff.
